summary: Prototype projection rules passed five local-emulator structural authorization tests. Owners can read their projections; all client writes, cross-account reads, filing evidence writes, session writes, and ticket writes were denied. This is not production acceptance or an audit of every repository rule.

findings.issue: Admin SDK projection and recovery paths bypass client rules; their deployed IAM, delivery ordering, and genuine lifecycle behavior remain unverified.
findings.recommendation: Keep hosted features disabled until deployed-service ownership and lifecycle acceptance checks pass. Preserve server-only writes.
